008package paint.viewer.ui.dialogs;
009
010import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
011
012import javax.swing.*;
013import java.awt.*;
014import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
015import java.util.Map;
016
017/**
018 * A dialog window for assigning actions related to a specific cell within a
019 * grid-like interface. The dialog allows users to select a cell via radio
020 * buttons and perform actions such as assigning, undoing, canceling, or
021 * closing the dialog.
022 *
023 * <p>The selection is visually represented by a colored square alongside
024 * radio buttons, where the colors correspond to specific cells. The dialog
025 * interacts with a {@link CellAssignmentDialog.Listener} interface for
026 * handling user actions.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Features of this dialog include:</p>
029 * <ul>
030 *   <li>Modeless behavior to remain accessible alongside the parent frame.</li>
031 *   <li>Dynamic creation of cell options based on the number of supported cells.</li>
032 *   <li>Visual UI components with color-coded squares and radio buttons.</li>
033 *   <li>Scrollable layout for handling a large number of cells.</li>
034 * </ul>
035 */
036public class CellAssignmentDialog extends JDialog {
037
038    /** Listener interface for handling cell assignment actions. */
039    public interface Listener {
040        /**
041         * Called when the user clicks 'Assign' for a specific cell ID.
042         *
043         * @param cellId the selected cell ID
044         */
045        void onAssign(int cellId);
046
047        /**
048         * Called when the user clicks 'Undo'.
049         */
050        void onUndo();
051
052        /**
053         * Called when the user clicks 'Cancel Selection'.
054         */
055        void onCancelSelection();
056    }
057
058    private final ButtonGroup group                       = new ButtonGroup();
059    private final Map<JRadioButton, JPanel> squareByRadio = new LinkedHashMap<>();
060
061    /**
062     * Constructs a modeless dialog for assigning cells to selected regions
063     * within the viewer.
064     *
065     * @param owner    the parent frame owning this dialog
066     * @param listener a {@link Listener} implementation to handle user actions
067     */
068    public CellAssignmentDialog(Frame owner, Listener listener) {
069        super(owner, "Assign Cells", false);
070        setDefaultCloseOperation(DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE);
071        setLayout(new BorderLayout());
072
073        JPanel list = new JPanel();
074        list.setLayout(new BoxLayout(list, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
075
076        // --- ID 0: No cell ---
077        list.add(createCellRow(0, "No cell", Color.GRAY, true));
078
079        // --- IDs 1..N vertically ---
080        int cellCount = SquareGridPanel.getSupportedCellCount();
081        for (int id = 1; id <= cellCount; id++) {
082            Color c = SquareGridPanel.getColorForCell(id);
083            list.add(createCellRow(id, "Assign to cell " + id, c, false));
084        }
085
086        JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(list,
087                                             JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED,
088                                             JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER);
089        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
090
091        // --- Controls ---
092        JPanel  buttons   = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT));
093        JButton assignBtn = new JButton("Assign");
094        JButton undoBtn   = new JButton("Undo");
095        JButton cancelBtn = new JButton("Cancel");
096        JButton closeBtn  = new JButton("Close");
097
098        assignBtn.addActionListener(e -> listener.onAssign(getSelectedCellId()));
099        undoBtn.addActionListener(  e -> listener.onUndo());
100        cancelBtn.addActionListener(e -> listener.onCancelSelection());
101        closeBtn.addActionListener( e -> dispose());
102
103        buttons.add(assignBtn);
104        buttons.add(undoBtn);
105        buttons.add(cancelBtn);
106        buttons.add(closeBtn);
107        add(buttons, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
108
109        pack();
110        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
111        updateVisualSelection();
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * Creates a panel row with a colored square and an associated radio button
116     * for selecting a particular cell.
117     *
118     * @param cellId   unique identifier for the cell
119     * @param label    descriptive label for the radio button
120     * @param baseColor the color to display for this cell
121     * @param selected whether this option should be preselected
122     * @return a configured JPanel containing the radio button and color square
123     */
124    private JPanel createCellRow(int cellId, String label, Color baseColor, boolean selected) {
125        JPanel row = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 8, 6));
126
127        JRadioButton radio = new JRadioButton(label);
128        radio.setForeground(Color.BLACK);
129        radio.putClientProperty("cellId", cellId);
130        if (selected) {
131            radio.setSelected(true);
132        }
133        group.add(radio);
134
135        JPanel square = new JPanel() {
136            @Override
137            public Dimension getPreferredSize() {
138                return new Dimension(20, 20);
139            }
140
141            @Override
142            protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
143                super.paintComponent(g);
144                g.setColor(baseColor);
145                g.drawRect(1, 1, getWidth() - 3, getHeight() - 3);
146            }
147        };
148        square.setBackground(Color.WHITE);
149        square.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY, 1));
150        square.setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.HAND_CURSOR));
151
152        squareByRadio.put(radio, square);
153
154        radio.addActionListener(e -> updateVisualSelection());
155        square.addMouseListener(new java.awt.event.MouseAdapter() {
156            @Override
157            public void mouseClicked(java.awt.event.MouseEvent e) {
158                radio.setSelected(true);
159                updateVisualSelection();
160            }
161        });
162
163        row.add(square);
164        row.add(radio);
165        return row;
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * Retrieves the cell ID associated with the selected radio button.
170     *
171     * @return the selected cell ID, or 0 if no selection is active
172     */
173    private int getSelectedCellId() {
174        for (JRadioButton radioButton : squareByRadio.keySet()) {
175            if (radioButton.isSelected()) {
176                Object v = radioButton.getClientProperty("cellId");
177                if (v instanceof Integer cellId) {
178                    return cellId;
179                }
180            }
181        }
182        return 0;
183    }
184
185    /**
186     * Updates the visual appearance of the colored squares to reflect the
187     * currently selected radio button.
188     */
189    private void updateVisualSelection() {
190        for (Map.Entry<JRadioButton, JPanel> e : squareByRadio.entrySet()) {
191            JRadioButton radioButton = e.getKey();
192            JPanel       square      = e.getValue();
193            int          id          = (Integer) radioButton.getClientProperty("cellId");
194            Color        base        = (id == 0) ? Color.GRAY : SquareGridPanel.getColorForCell(id);
195
196            if (radioButton.isSelected()) {
197                square.setBackground(base);
198                square.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.BLACK, 2));
199            } else {
200                square.setBackground(Color.WHITE);
201                square.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY, 1));
202            }
203        }
204        repaint();
205    }
206}
